subprocess_flow.substep_name: Ingest Production Telemetry and Streaming Logs
subprocess_flow.description: Establish automated real-time telemetry streaming from operational AI model inference endpoints into the centralized MoJ observability platform. Capture model requests, responses, execution latency, error codes, and operational context with cryptographic log signing to preserve evidentiary integrity.
subprocess_flow.responsible_party: Chief Data Officer / Head of Data Governance
success_criteria: Telemetry streaming operational with sub-second latency
100% of production inference transactions ingested and cryptographically signed
Zero loss of streaming audit records
subprocess_flow.purpose: Provide real-time data ingestion and pipeline telemetry for operational AI systems to maintain complete system observability.
subprocess_flow.scope: All live inference transactions and telemetry pipelines for deployed AI models across MoJ infrastructure.
subprocess_flow.process_owner: MoJ Chief Enterprise Architect & Head of Data Governance
triggers: Live system activation and receipt of production inference requests
end_conditions: Telemetry ingestion streams active and publishing without unhandled packet drops

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Telemetry streaming pipeline failure leading to unmonitored production inference traffic
step_risks_and_controls.control: Implement dead-letter queuing, automated stream failover, and high-availability streaming collectors with buffer alerts

governance_requirements: NIST AI RMF - MANAGE function (Category 1: Observability)
MoJ Records Management & Retention Policy (7-year rule)

change_management.change_request_process: Telemetry schema updates submitted through standard GitOps MLOps pipeline review
change_management.versioning_rules: Streaming configuration scripts and schemas semantically versioned in Git

subprocess_flow.description: Execute automated statistical profiling routines across continuous streaming telemetry comparing incoming operational data distributions and predictive patterns against baseline training profiles. Identify covariate shift, feature degradation, and target concept drift using standardized distance metrics.
subprocess_flow.responsible_party: Chief Data Officer / Head of Data Governance
dependencies: Ingest Production Telemetry and Streaming Logs
success_criteria: Automated drift analysis completed across 100% of input features
Statistical divergence scores calculated against certified baseline
Zero unprofiled feature dimensions in operational inference data
subprocess_flow.purpose: Detect emergent data quality anomalies and model behavioral shifts before they result in erroneous justice outcomes.
subprocess_flow.scope: All operational features, intermediate embeddings, and output distribution vectors for active models.
subprocess_flow.process_owner: MoJ Chief Enterprise Architect & Head of Data Governance
triggers: Arrival of continuous streaming telemetry batches or inference log events
end_conditions: Drift metrics computed, recorded in catalog, and ready for threshold evaluation

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Undetected gradual concept drift resulting in skewed operational decisions
step_risks_and_controls.control: Continuous statistical distance tests with automated rolling window baseline comparisons

governance_requirements: UK AI Regulation Monitoring Principles - Accuracy & Robustness

change_management.change_request_process: Drift calculation rule updates undergo technical peer review via MLOps registry
change_management.versioning_rules: Metric algorithms and drift configurations tracked in version control repository

subprocess_flow.substep_name: Dispatch Automated Drift and Incident Alerts
subprocess_flow.description: Evaluate calculated drift and performance indicators against mandatory MoJ operational tolerance thresholds. Automatically dispatch real-time incident notifications to technical owners and trigger retraining workflows or automated failsafe fallbacks when thresholds are breached.
inputs: MoJ AI Governance Alerting Threshold Configuration
success_criteria: Automated alerts dispatched within 5 minutes of threshold breach
Retraining or mitigation tickets created in MoJ ITSM platform automatically
Zero unhandled critical drift breach events
subprocess_flow.purpose: Provide immediate alerting and trigger rapid incident intervention when model parameters exceed acceptable boundaries.
subprocess_flow.scope: Threshold alerting triggers and automated incident routing across all justice AI operational deployments.
subprocess_flow.process_owner: MoJ Chief Enterprise Architect & Head of Data Governance
triggers: Drift calculation exceeding pre-established governance boundary parameters
end_conditions: Alert notifications successfully routed and incident tracking ticket generated

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Alert fatigue or dropped notifications allowing degraded models to persist in live operation
step_risks_and_controls.control: Automated paging escalation matrix, mandatory acknowledgment timers, and fail-safe circuit breaker controls

governance_requirements: NIST AI RMF - MANAGE function (Category 2: Response & Recovery)
MoJ Digital & Technology Incident Management Standard

change_management.change_request_process: Threshold modifications require approval from MoJ AI Technical Review Panel
change_management.versioning_rules: Threshold policy definitions versioned under GitOps configuration repository

subprocess_flow.substep_name: Generate Real-Time Telemetry and Operational Dashboards
subprocess_flow.description: Aggregate continuous telemetry streams, data quality metrics, drift alerts, and system health status into interactive dashboards and scheduled health reports. Render transparent operational views accessible to enterprise architects, operational owners, and data governance boards.
subprocess_flow.responsible_party: Chief Data Officer / Head of Data Governance
outputs: Real-Time Automated Drift Alerting and Telemetry Stream Log
subprocess_flow.estimated_duration: Continuous dashboard refresh / Monthly report delivery
dependencies: Dispatch Automated Drift and Incident Alerts
success_criteria: Telemetry dashboard uptime maintained at 99.9% availability
Monthly AI Operational Health Report published on schedule
Executive metrics visible across data quality, drift, and system health
subprocess_flow.purpose: Deliver ongoing stakeholder transparency and executive visibility into production AI behavior and compliance.
subprocess_flow.scope: Operational reporting, visual dashboards, and monthly service performance disclosures across active AI systems.
subprocess_flow.process_owner: MoJ Chief Enterprise Architect & Head of Data Governance
triggers: Continuous streaming data updates and monthly reporting calendar milestones
end_conditions: Dashboard metrics updated in real-time and monthly report delivered to governance bodies

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Inaccurate or stale dashboard metrics obscuring production performance degradation
step_risks_and_controls.control: Real-time dashboard health heartbeat monitoring and automated data pipeline freshness checks

governance_requirements: UK AI Regulation Monitoring Principles - Transparency

change_management.change_request_process: Dashboard metric updates requested via Enterprise Data Architecture working group
change_management.versioning_rules: Reporting templates and dashboard definitions maintained in semantic Git repositories

subprocess_flow.substep_name: Execute Annual Re-Certification and Compliance Audit
subprocess_flow.description: Perform comprehensive annual formal audits on operational AI solutions to reassess model validity, algorithmic fairness, security posture, and regulatory compliance. Compile all historical telemetry, retraining logs, and incident records into a comprehensive re-certification audit dossier and archive all materials under the mandatory 7-year MoJ retention policy.
subprocess_flow.responsible_party: Independent Model Auditor / Quality Assurance Lead
inputs: Real-Time Automated Drift Alerting and Telemetry Stream Log
outputs: Updated Conformance Certification or Retirement Directive
dependencies: Generate Real-Time Telemetry and Operational Dashboards
success_criteria: Completion of independent annual audit assessing bias, security, and accuracy
Audit dossier archived into immutable repository under 7-year retention rule
Formal issuance of annual re-certification or documented decommissioning plan
subprocess_flow.purpose: Provide independent regulatory and architectural verification that active models remain compliant, fair, and legally sound over extended operational lifecycles.
subprocess_flow.scope: Full annual lifecycle review of deployed model weights, training updates, operational telemetry, and regulatory alignment.
subprocess_flow.process_owner: MoJ Chief Enterprise Architect & Head of Data Governance
triggers: Annual operational deployment anniversary or major regulatory audit directive
end_conditions: MoJ AI Governance Board approval of re-certification dossier and formal archiving of audit trail

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Regulatory non-compliance or undetected algorithmic bias emerging across prolonged production lifespans
step_risks_and_controls.control: Mandatory independent auditor review, comprehensive bias regression re-testing, and executive board sign-off

governance_requirements: NIST AI RMF - MANAGE function (Category 4: Continuous Audit)
UK National AI Strategy Monitoring Principles
MoJ Records Management & Retention Policy (7-year rule)
EU AI Act Post-Market Monitoring Guidelines

change_management.change_request_process: Re-certification outcomes and recommended modifications submitted to MoJ AI Governance Board
change_management.versioning_rules: Annual audit dossier and certification artifacts assigned immutable cryptographic hashes in archive

improvement_inputs: Benchmarking against UK AI Safety Institute guidance
